title: Week 1 Basic: Accounts (Windows)
readme:
You administer this computer. A security review found account problems. Fix them without removing people the company needs.

Authorized users: alice, bob.
Authorized administrators: you (the account you log in with).

Company policy:
  - Only authorized users may have accounts.
  - Only authorized administrators may be in the Administrators group.
  - The Guest account must be disabled.
  - The built-in Administrator account must be disabled.

There are 5 problems, 20 points each. Do not delete alice or bob.

checks.message: bob is no longer an administrator

pass.cmd:
$g = Get-LocalUser | Where-Object { $_.SID.Value -like '*-501' }
if ($g -and -not $g.Enabled) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }

checks.message: The built-in Administrator account is disabled

pass.cmd:
$a = Get-LocalUser | Where-Object { $_.SID.Value -like '*-500' }
if ($a -and -not $a.Enabled) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }
